extDesc.message: Shows only today's tasks on every new tab, helping you focus on one thing now.

onboardingGuide.message: First step: type just one thing on your mind, then press Enter to add it.

emptyStateTitle.message: Start with one task for today

emptyStateDescription.message: This space keeps only what you want to do today. Add one small, finishable task to begin.

emptyStateExample.message: Examples: "Tidy for 10 minutes" or "Reply to one email."

emptyStateStepInput.message: Write one thing you want to finish today in the input.

emptyStateStepReturn.message: After you add it, you can check it whenever you open a new tab.

emptyTasks.message: No tasks yet. Add one thing to do today.

allTasksComplete.message: Everything for today is complete. Nice work.

taskKeyboardHelp.message: Use Tab to reach task controls. Use Up/Down to move between tasks and Left/Right to move between controls for the same task.
